title: KubeAtlas rule pack metadata (rego_api v1)
description: Schema every metadata.yaml in this catalogue must satisfy. The KubeAtlas binary's loader (pkg/extractor/rego/loader.go) enforces the same fields; this JSON Schema is what the offline metadata-validator checks before a PR lands.

name.description: Pack name. Lowercase, hyphenated. Must match the directory name + the OCI repository tail (ghcr.io/lithastra/rules/<name>).

version.description: Pack semver. Tag for OCI release is <name>/v<version>.

rego_api.description: KubeAtlas Rego interface contract version. v1 is the only value the engine currently supports.

kubeatlas.description: Semver constraint against the running KubeAtlas binary. Examples: '>= 1.0.0', '>= 1.2.0, < 2.0.0'.

maintainers.description: GitHub handles of pack stewards. Optional; falls back to MAINTAINERS.md when empty.

modules.description: Each module is one .rego file with a declared GVK match. Engine routes per-resource events to modules whose match covers the resource's (group, kind).

name.description: Module identifier within the pack. Lowercase, hyphenated.

file.description: Path to the .rego file relative to the pack root.

entrypoint.description: Fully-qualified Rego query the engine evaluates. Convention: data.kubeatlas.<pack>.<module>.derive.

match.description: GVK narrowing: empty group + empty kind means catch-all. Engine matches by Group + Kind only; Version variation is handled inside the rule.
